reply.thought: The user has provided a list of refunds reported as applied and a list of refunds requested in the batch. I need to compare these two lists to ensure every requested refund is present in the applied refunds. If there's a discrepancy, I must call hold(). Otherwise, I will proceed to pay the net balance for each customer using list_orders() to identify customers, then use net_balance() and record_payout(). First, I will check for missing refunds.

I have listed the orders. Now I need to compare the requested refunds with the applied refunds.
